tools.name: get_washbodega_services
tools.description: Return verified public Wash & Fold and pickup/delivery availability in English or Spanish. Read only; never collects personal data or creates an order.

tools.name: get_washbodega_pricing
tools.description: Return verified public pricing and minimums for Wash & Fold or pickup/delivery. Read only; specialty and commercial quotes are excluded.

tools.name: get_washbodega_location_hours
tools.description: Return the verified store location, scoped 24/7 customer-access hours, and the owner-confirmed 24/7 staffing without implying service-specific availability.

tools.name: get_washbodega_pickup_delivery_policy
tools.description: Return the public route-qualification policy without accepting an address, ZIP code, location, or other personal data.

tools.name: get_washbodega_ordering_handoff
tools.description: Return the Cents ordering link and its limits. This read-only tool does not open the link, submit data, confirm a route, create an order, or take payment.
